bio: Ideally situated opposite Victoria Station, the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel London Victoria is surrounded by many of London's main points of interest. Major attractions, such as Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament, Soho, and Trafalgar Square are all within walking distance.  Housed within the DoubleTree by Hilton London-victoria Hotel is the stylish contemporary restaurant, 2 Bridge Place. Newly renovated, this engaging venue with its Modern European-influences is the an ideal setting for a relaxing Afternoon Tea.
